scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained. Finite computations are corroborating tests rather than infinite certificates. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Lower bound only: the exact minimal cactus-NFA size is not determined.
The alphabet size grows; this does not establish a fixed-alphabet state penalty.
The NFA is epsilon-free with one initial state; the transition graph is treated as undirected and simple.
The relevant recent primary paper was inspected in full; historical priority beyond that literature remains provisional.
title: A linear alphabet-size penalty for cactus NFAs recognizing independent parity
